Projection singularities are outside the finite-input contract. Layer grouping and source scale selection remain recipe policy.
resolved_source_corrections.per_layer_knn_search: Fit each layer index and perform configured k-neighbor and radius queries, preserving grouping and source result ordering. Sparse or exhausted layers reject explicitly; fitted index objects are in-process objects, not portable serialized models.
resolved_source_corrections.circle_from_three_points: Fit the circumcircle, retaining source large-radius tangent handling for supported collinear or coincident configurations. resolved_source_corrections.helix_cylinder_intersection: Compute candidate cylinder intersections, select forward motion, apply axial bounds and optional correction, and retry later layers under source recursion rules. resolved_source_corrections.perturbative_helix_correction: Apply supplied per-layer interpolated correction maps with source orientation and curvature scaling, masks, missing-value handling and geometry guards. resolved_source_corrections.helix_nearest_point_distance: Compute the source fixed-iteration Newton approximation to nearest helix position and distance, with three iterations in the tracking recipe. No global minimum or convergence guarantee; finite qualified outputs only. Optional phase/arc outputs are outside this graph boundary.
resolved_source_corrections.bayesian_neighbor_evaluation: Combine tangent residuals, supplied uncertainty information and local background-density policy to classify neighboring candidates. Source thresholds and uncertainty coefficients remain explicit recipe policy; missing-map behavior is preserved, not statistical calibration certification.
resolved_source_corrections.greedy_track_commit: Rank candidates by descending recipe quality, then greedily claim available observations under configured minimum-count and loss bounds across commit rounds. The reusable commit primitive consumes caller ordering and supports reserve-skipped policy; the source lifecycle supplies reserve_skipped=False. No global assignment optimum is claimed.
